card.name: First piece of a drug name after a verb
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name (often a single capital letter like C or Hal) that comes right after a verb or phrase such as applied, remove, take, or administration of. The name is split into pieces and the rest follows.

modes.label: Capitalized brand name start
modes.description: First letter or two of an all-caps brand name after an instruction verb.

modes.label: Generic name start
modes.description: Opening piece of a generic drug name after of or including.

modes.label: Enzyme or drug after and
modes.description: Start of a drug or enzyme name after a linking word.

card.plain: It fires on the very first piece of a drug name that has been split up, right after words like take, remove or administration of.
